description: Search NCI GDC cancer cases (patients/samples) by primary site and/or project. Returns case_id, submitter_id, primary site, disease type and project_id. Keyless, open-access metadata.

primary_site.description: Primary anatomic site, e.g. "Kidney", "Breast", "Bronchus and lung".

project_id.description: Restrict to a GDC project, e.g. "TCGA-BRCA".

name: search_cases
